now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 44, General Talbot keeps hunting S.H.I.E.L.D., until Coulson wins him over as an uneasy ally.

proposed.text: In episode 36, General Talbot keeps hunting S.H.I.E.L.D., until Coulson wins him over as an uneasy ally.

changes.evidence: Talbot's season 2 appearances end at 2x14 'Love in the Time of Hydra' (episode 36), where he is already cooperating with Coulson and calls him about Ward and Bakshi; he does not appear in episode 44 (2x22).

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 103, Ruby, raised by HYDRA, cuts off Yo-Yo's arms.

proposed.text: In episode 99, Ruby, raised by HYDRA, cuts off Yo-Yo's arms.

changes.evidence: Ruby throws her chakram and cuts off both of Yo-Yo's arms in 5x11 'All the Comforts of Home' (episode 99, ref AoS511), not in episode 103 'Rise and Shine'.

now.title: Daredevil S3
now.text: In episode 7, Inmate Jasper Evans stabs Fisk on Fisk's own orders, getting him moved out of prison.

proposed.text: In episode 2, Inmate Jasper Evans stabs Fisk on Fisk's own orders, getting him moved out of prison.

changes.evidence: Evans stages the stabbing of Fisk in the Rikers gym in Daredevil S3 episode 2 'Please' (ref DD302); episode 7 only has his 1991 backstory. This also fixes the order (record 0 was tagged 7, record 1 is episode 6).

now.title: Luke Cage S2
now.text: In episode 8, Years earlier, Detective Scarfe partners with Misty, jails Cockroach Hamilton, and breaks down after his son Earl dies.

proposed.text: In episode 5, Years earlier, Detective Scarfe partners with Misty, jails Cockroach Hamilton, and breaks down after his son Earl dies.

changes.evidence: The flashbacks of Scarfe framing Cockroach with Misty and breaking down after Earl's death are in Luke Cage S2 episode 5 'All Souled Out' (ref LC205); Scarfe's only on-screen S2 appearance is LC205, he is only mentioned in episode 8.

now.title: Agent Carter
now.text: In episode 2, a Roxxon scientist turns Howard Stark's stolen formula into nitramene bombs at one of the company's oil refineries.

proposed.text: In episode 1, a Roxxon scientist turns Howard Stark's stolen formula into nitramene bombs at one of the company's oil refineries.

changes.evidence: Miles Van Ert builds nitramene bombs with Leet Brannis at the Roxxon Refinery, which Peggy finds and which implodes, in Agent Carter episode 1 'Now Is Not the End' (ref AC101); episode 2 only has the aftermath and Van Ert's arrest.

proposed.title: Iron Fist S2
proposed.text: In episode 9, Joy turns on Davos and lets his hostage BB go. Davos leaves her badly hurt, and Ward carries her to safety.

changes.evidence: In Iron Fist S2 episode 9 'War Without End', Joy betrays Davos (BB gets away, she tells him he stole the Fist), Davos injures her, and Ward shoots Chen Wu and carries her away (ref IF209). The file ends with her still working with Davos.

owner_calls.question: These Raft files use the status 'Active', which is not in the Raft status list (At large, In custody, Captive, Deceased, Missing, Allied). Keep 'Active' for free, openly operating figures (senators, mayors, officers, companies), or map them to a Raft status?
options: Keep 'Active' as allowed on Raft files
Map case by case ('Allied' for Talbot/Scarfe/Schoonover-era allies, 'At large' for the rest)
owner_calls.evidence: BRIEF lists Raft statuses without 'Active'; the facts behind each record are otherwise correct.
